description: Keep the final reply in the user's conversational language, 2–4 short sentences (25–60 words): report the verified result and ask ONE relevant optional next-step question about ONE action, not a choice menu. Mandatory missing details take priority. Suggestions never perform actions automatically; respect requests for no suggestions. Saved links let friends join without accounts. If CURRENT received UI context or actual host evidence confirms the same saved plan and last-action module are already open, do not call open_planner again; realtime updates the existing view. Historic context is insufficient. Otherwise open the last-action module with the selected credentials, or honor an explicit opening request. Record a shared expense, split equally. paid_by defaults to the person you act for; split_among defaults to everyone in the plan. Requires a user-requested amount, currency, payer and equal-split participants; missing or ambiguous details need clarification. Service use restrictions: plan creation, participation and edits for users known to be under 13 (or a higher local minimum) are prohibited, including under a nickname. Personal data about known underage children, sensitive medical records, intimate content, card details, government IDs, passwords and verification codes are prohibited planning input. This tool covers ordinary non-sensitive group planning only.

allow_duplicate.description: Only if the user confirms a second, identical expense within 10 minutes (otherwise it is treated as a retry).

amount.description: Total, max 2 decimals (e.g. 42.5). Send a plain number.

currency.description: ISO code, e.g. CZK or EUR. Sets the plan's currency if it has no expenses yet; otherwise must match it (see get_plan currency).

description.description: What it was for, e.g. "Groceries" (max 120 chars).

paid_by_participant_id.description: Who paid (participant_id from get_plan, or their exact name). Defaults to you.

plan.description: Saved plan link (e.g. https://lesgooo.fun/ab12/when) or its 4-character id. Bare module links such as https://lesgooo.fun/when are local drafts: ask for a saved link, never substitute a previous plan ID.

split_among.description: Who shares the cost (participant_id values or exact names). Defaults to everyone.
